title: Anthropic 成立公共利益基金，承诺将约 20% 股份投入公益并持续扩增
summary: Anthropic 宣布成立 Anthropic Public Benefit Fund，将约 20% 公司股份逐步注入该实体，用于应对 AI 带来的劳动力市场冲击等社会问题，股份比例随公司估值增长自动扩大。
summary_en: Anthropic announced the creation of the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, a new LLC that will receive 5% of Anthropic shares immediately and an additional 2% for every 50% increase in company valuation above baseline, with the total potentially reaching roughly 20% of shares. The Fund will address societal challenges from AI such as labor market disruption and may fund traditional nonprofits or direct distributions. None of the Fund's equity will be used for lobbying. Combined with existing co-founder and employee equity donation programs, approximately 20% of Anthropic shares are now dedicated to public benefit.
body:
Anthropic 宣布成立 Anthropic Public Benefit Fund，将约 20% 公司股份逐步注入该实体，用于应对 AI 带来的劳动力市场冲击等社会问题，股份比例随公司估值增长自动扩大。

Anthropic
- Anthropic 成立公共利益基金，承诺将约 20% 股份投入公益 — 将 5% 股份立即注入公益基金，估值每涨 50% 再追加 2%，总比例最终接近 20%，专门用于应对 AI 劳动力冲击等社会问题，且禁止用于游说。
  https://www.anthropic.com/news/public-benefit-fund
- Anthropic 引入 METR 评估团队，给予等同于员工的深度访问权限 — 按白宫超智能协议要求，METR 六名员工已入职 Anthropic 获得内部权限，将公开发布风险评估结果，Hugging Face 等机构也在洽谈中。
  https://www.anthropic.com/news/an-update-on-independent-evaluators

Google DeepMind
- DeepMind 与新加坡政府合作，在端侧部署 AI 诈骗检测模型 — 双方联合打造精调模型部署于移动设备，在不依赖云端的情况下本地识别诈骗内容，强化公民数字安全（10 月 14 日）。
  https://deepmind.google/blog/on-device-ai-scam-detection-mddi

Source: https://www.anthropic.com/news/public-benefit-fund
